Set within the opulent and deeply sequestered confines of an imperial palace, the narrative follows a young apothecary named Maomao, who is abruptly kidnapped and sold into indentured servitude as a low-ranking maid. Possessing extensive knowledge of poisons, medicine, and pharmacological experimentation gained from her upbringing in the dangerous pleasure districts, she strives to keep a low profile until her term of service concludes. However, her keen intellect and irrepressible curiosity get the better of her when she secretly intervenes to thwart a series of mysterious illnesses threatening the emperor's infant heirs. Her unauthorized medical intervention catches the attention of Jinshi, an influential and remarkably handsome eunuch court official who quickly recognizes her unique talents. Drafted into service as a personal poison taster and investigator, Maomao finds herself repeatedly drawn into solving intricate court intrigues, medical puzzles, and palace mysteries, utilizing her unorthodox methods and scientific acumen to untangle the secrets hidden behind the high walls of the inner court.

薄暗く、どこか古びた佇まいの空間に、一人の少女が静かに佇んでいます。彼女は全体を横から見た姿で、視線は手に持つ花の方へと柔らかく落とされ、まるでその香りを確かめるように、そっと顔を近づけているのです。
髪は艶やかな黒で、長めの髪を後ろでゆるく三つ編みにして束ね、右の耳元には持っている花と同じ種類の鮮やかなオレンジ色の花が一輪、飾られています。前髪は目にかかるくらいの長さで、閉じたまぶたの線が穏やかで、心が落ち着いている様子が伝わってきます。
